contexts.text: This disposition lies deeply hidden... like conjugial love, which in infancy... lies hidden... In like manner in... every plant there lies inmostly hidden the endeavour to produce fruit or seeds... So the Conjugial of good and truth long lies hidden...
(After death) the happiness which had lain hidden in... the interior man, comes forth...

We shall lie hidden a man from his companion () = separation relatively to the things of the Church. To lie hidden, here, = separation... These are said to lie hidden, because they are separated as to good and truth...
This root (of evil) lies deeply hidden...
This represented that they want to lie completely hidden.
What is Divinely inspired lies hidden in them...
The internal sense is not only that sense which lies hidden in the external sense...
The falsities... in which good lies hidden... The falsities... in which evil lies hidden...
These loves, like the hidden current of a river... NJHD 56.
This lies hidden in everyone who is in the love of self...
What wisdom... lies hidden in the Word...
This lies inmostly hidden in all evil...
